class: A section-level exception was applied to unrelated fields across the entire page
symptom: Architecture review and synthetic regressions reproduced a required password or one-time code being ignored when an optional account heading was elsewhere on the page.
site: Any application mixing optional account creation with required authentication or verification
root_cause: Account detection and owner blockers searched the whole snapshot for an optional account heading instead of proving that the credential belonged to that section. Duplicate labels carried no field identity.
why_tests_missed: The earlier optional-password fix had only saved-page interpretation replay coverage. It had no mixed-section browser scenarios or assertions on account and handover decisions.
fix: Share field-local section evidence between account detection and owner blockers. Bound headings by hierarchy and container lifetime, match password references and labels conservatively, preserve unknown DOM passwords, and never apply the password exception to verification codes. Mixed password forms are handed over before generic authentication helpers can fill the wrong section.
prevention: Attach exceptions to identified fields and their section evidence. Test mixed sections, duplicate labels, unknown credentials, and browser action outcomes rather than only snapshot interpretation.
